item.title: Three Coins in the Fountain
item.description: Three American roommates find the men of their dreams after throwing coins into Rome's magical Trevi Fountain.

item.title: Made In Hollywood: Teen Edition
item.description: "Special Effects" - Career information on how teens can pursue a career in the field of Special Effects. Interviews with and career advice from the professionals at Industrial Light & Magic and WETA Digital. Featuring "Transformers", "King Kong" and "Star Wars: The Revenge of the Sith".

item.title: Made In Hollywood: Teen Edition
item.description: "Casting Directors" - Career information on how teens can pursue a career as a Casting Director. Interviews with and career advice from Denise Chamian, Jane Jenkins, Janet Hirschenson, and Pam Dixon.

item.title: Getting Green
item.description: "Getting Green" is a weekly half-hour series that explores our global environment and promotes responsible behavior that helps to both protect the environment and save energy costs.

item.title: Dog Tales Classics
item.description: "Dog Tales" showcases dogs and dog lovers of all types, providing valuable information about canine health, training, grooming and overall dog care.

item.title: Fractured Flickers
item.description: Hans Conried and celebrity guests present dubbed over silent picture film clips.

item.title: Foreign Correspondent
item.description: A crime reporter is sent to Europe as a foreign correspondent and soon finds himself in over his head when he uncovers a spy ring.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: A cat tries to get a canary out of its cage in a Sylvester and tweety fashion.
